**Sugar** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A large container of sugar. It can be eaten to replenish an extremely low amount of hunger, but is better used as an ingredient in cooking.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Snaptail Reed (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Snaptail Reed | | Sugar (1) | 

- Six can be found in an apartment northwest of the Point Pleasant bus stop.
- Four can be found inside Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go.
- Two can be found inside The Giant Teapot.
- Two can be found in the kitchen at Freddy Fear's House of Scares.
- One can be found in the sink at White Powder Winter Sports.
- One can be found on the counter at Autumn Acre Cabin.
- One can be found in a tent at Sylvie & Sons Logging Camp.
- One can be found at The Crosshair.

The daily recommended intake of sugar is 47 grams. [1] [2] 

- ![](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/d/dc/Mappalachia_aid_seasonings.webp/135px-Mappalachia_aid_seasonings.webp) Sugar locations

1. ↑ Nate: *" {reading the label on the box of sugar bombs} Sugar Bombs... 100% daily value of sugar..."*
(Sole Survivor's dialogue)
2. ↑ Announcer: *"Worry no more, mom! Just turn to Sugar Bombs: America's leading breakfast cereal. Just add cold milk and your family has a delicious and nutritious breakfast. With 47 grams of sugar per serving, you can feel confident your loved ones will have the energy they need to face the day!"*
(Pirate radio advertisement)
